summary: The dataset contains information and functionalities related to the Agreement module in a system, which involves template and history management, agreement adding, updating, searching, and content handling.
purpose: To manage agreements, including adding new agreements, updating existing ones, displaying them based on different criteria, and handling their templates and history.

entities.name: Agreement
entities.description: Represents an agreement within the system, containing various attributes like ID, TypeID, DescriptionCodeID, TemplateID, etc.

entities.name: HSPnetSession
entities.description: Session object used to interact with the database, handle parameters, and execute stored procedures.

actors.name: User
roles: Can view or edit agreements depending on permissions

actors.name: System
roles: Executes stored procedures for adding, updating, deleting agreements

workflows.name: Agreement Management
steps: User interacts with the agreement interface.
System checks user permissions and agreement existence.
System provides template and history URLs based on agreement status.
User can add, update, or delete agreements if permissions allow.

business_rules: Agreements can only be viewed or edited by users with appropriate permissions.
Templates are displayed or hidden based on agreement existence and user permissions.
validations: Validating agreement existence before displaying or editing templates.
Checking user permissions for editing agreements.
conditions: If agreement exists, show template and history tools.
If user can edit, provide navigation URLs to edit agreements.
system_behavior: System executes stored procedures for managing agreements and their details.
Provides visual indicators for agreement status and subscription.
exceptions: Template records may not exist initially.
